name: Playground Lab
description: A 3D physics playground with a slingshot, catapult, seesaw, trampoline, dominoes, moon gravity and slow motion.

about.concept: Intuitive physics by experiment. A slingshot, catapult, seesaw, trampoline and dominoes let the child vary force, angle, mass and gravity and watch the result, in slow motion when it helps.
about.progression: Free play comes first: a physics playground with a slingshot, catapult, seesaw, trampoline, dominoes, moon gravity and slow motion. The Challenges ladder then sets goals in that same playground, from pushing a ball onto a mat and knocking down pins in pre-K, through bounces, domino chains, launch speed and balancing a beam, to predicting speeds, momentum and where a launched ball lands with Newton's laws in 8th grade.
lifeSkills: Adjusting one thing at a time
